name: Executor AO
summary: Executor AO is an Expert Advisor that trades based on Awesome Oscillator (AO) signals, entering positions when the oscillator crosses above or below the zero line and confirming with momentum shifts. It applies systematic entry and exit rules derived from Bill Williams' Awesome Oscillator philosophy, using color changes and zero-line crossovers as primary trade triggers. The EA manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels while filtering trades based on signal strength.
summary_zh: Executor AO是一个基于动量震荡指标(Awesome Oscillator)信号进行交易的智能交易系统，当震荡指标穿越零线或出现动量转换时开仓。它采用比尔·威廉姆斯的动量震荡指标哲学，以颜色变化和零线交叉作为主要交易触发条件。该EA通过可配置的止损止盈水平管理仓位，并根据信号强度过滤交易。
strategy_analysis: Executor AO的核心策略基于比尔·威廉姆斯的动量震荡指标(Awesome Oscillator)，该指标通过计算5周期和34周期中位价的差值来衡量市场动量。入场条件为：当AO从负值区域穿越零线向上时产生买入信号，当AO从正值区域穿越零线向下时产生卖出信号，部分变体还会结合AO柱状图颜色变化（由红转绿或由绿转红）作为辅助确认。出场条件包括触及固定止盈/止损水平，以及AO出现反向交叉信号时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户设置固定手数或基于资金比例的动态仓位，但通常采用固定手数模式。资金管理依赖于止损距离与账户余额的比例关系，部分版本支持风险百分比计算仓位大小。整体策略属于典型的动量跟踪型方法，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能产生较多假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of Executor AO is based on Bill Williams' Awesome Oscillator, which measures market momentum by calculating the difference between 5-period and 34-period median prices. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when AO crosses the zero line upward from negative territory, and a sell signal is generated when AO crosses the zero line downward from positive territory; some variants also incorporate AO histogram color changes (red-to-green or green-to-red) as supplementary confirmation. Exit conditions include hitting fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels, and closing positions when AO produces a reverse crossover signal. Position sizing allows users to set fixed lots or dynamic sizing based on account equity percentage, though fixed lot mode is more commonly used. Money management relies on the relationship between stop-loss distance and account balance ratio, with some versions supporting risk-percentage-based lot calculation. The overall strategy is a typical momentum-following approach suited for trending markets, but it may generate numerous false signals in choppy or range-bound conditions.

pros: 基于经典动量指标，策略逻辑清晰易懂，适合初学者理解和使用
使用零线交叉作为信号过滤，减少了噪音交易，信号质量相对较高
参数可配置性强，允许用户根据不同品种和市场环境调整参数
结合止损止盈机制，单笔风险可控，不会出现无限亏损的情况
pros_en: Based on a classic momentum indicator with clear and understandable strategy logic, suitable for beginners
Uses zero-line crossover as signal filter, reducing noise trades and providing relatively high signal quality
Highly configurable parameters allow users to adjust settings for different instruments and market conditions
Incorporates stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms, keeping per-trade risk controllable without unlimited loss exposure
cons: 在震荡市或横盘市场中，AO零线交叉会产生大量假信号导致频繁亏损
缺少多时间框架确认和成交量过滤，单一指标策略的可靠性有限
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率(ATR)，在不同波动环境下风险收益比不一致
未实现新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: In choppy or range-bound markets, AO zero-line crossovers generate many false signals leading to frequent losses
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation and volume filtering, limiting the reliability of a single-indicator strategy
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit do not account for market volatility (ATR), resulting in inconsistent risk-reward ratios across varying volatility environments
Missing new bar check mechanism may cause repeated trade entries on the same bar
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，例如在H4趋势方向上执行H1的AO信号，提高信号可靠性
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自适应调整风险参数，避免在低波动时止损过宽或高波动时止盈过近
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, such as executing H1 AO signals only in the direction of the H4 trend, to improve signal reliability
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that adapts to market volatility, avoiding overly wide stops in low-volatility or tight targets in high-volatility conditions

risk_points: 单一指标策略在震荡市中容易连续亏损，缺乏趋势过滤可能导致资金回撤较大
未实现新K线检查，存在同一根K线重复开仓的风险，可能导致意外持仓叠加
risk_points_en: Single-indicator strategy prone to consecutive losses in sideways markets; lack of trend filter may lead to significant drawdowns
Missing new bar check creates risk of repeated entries on the same bar, potentially causing unintended position stacking
